purpose: what this person does for a living, in the player's own words and in the closest thing the rulebook has a page for
ask: the occupation concept the player gave; when it has no rulebook entry, the core rule applies: name the closest entries with a clause each and let the player choose or delegate

purpose: what this person relies on when things go wrong -- the body, the hands or the head -- so their real strength is theirs and not the dice's
ask: what the people who know them would say they are best at, or what they reach for first when a night turns bad

purpose: the one thing other people come to this person for, so it is the thing they are actually good at on the card
ask: what they get asked to do, or the thing they have done often enough that others rely on it

purpose: what this person has never been any good at, so their real weakness is theirs too
ask: never asked; filled only when the player volunteers it
